description: Accounts in the hand of ʿArūs b. Yūsuf. Three other pages of ʿArūs's accounts appear in the neighboring shelfmarks. Mentions brazilwood; a turban; wheat and wine; shipping expenses (? tawjīh); a Christian (al-naṣrānī); a foreign Christian (al-naṣrānī al-gharīb); and a Jewish yeast(?) merchant: al-yahūdī al-khamīrī.
